core_obligations: Verify that the hypotheses of the lemma are preserved by U-admissible blowups, by base changing and comparing the new blowups with the given local ones (proof lines 8930-8972).
Reduce, using successive blowups, to the case where S = Spec(A) and S minus U = V(a) for a nonzerodivisor a (proof lines 8974-8980).

Apply Lemma labelled lemma-push-ideal to obtain finite type ideals I_i with I_i O_{S_i} = J_i J'_i, blow up S in the product I_1 ... I_n, show the base change to S_i factors through S^*_i -> S_i, and conclude flatness of j_i^* F over S_i, then of F over S (proof lines 8982-9014).
proof_roadmap: Invariance of the hypotheses under U-admissible blowups (proof lines 8930-8972).
Reduction to the affine case with S minus U cut out by a nonzerodivisor (proof lines 8974-8980).
Split the ideals along the etale cover with Lemma labelled lemma-push-ideal (proof lines 8982-8988).
Blow up in the product of the ideals and descend flatness (proof lines 8990-9014).
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated S, a morphism X -> S, a quasi-coherent F on X and a quasi-compact open U of S, the lemma states that if there are finitely many diagrams with quasi-compact etale e_i : S_i -> S covering S, etale j_i : X_i -> X covering X and e_i^{-1}(U)-admissible blowups S^*_i -> S_i over which the strict transform of j_i^* F is flat, then some U-admissible blowup S' -> S makes the strict transform of F flat over S' (statement lines 8903-8928). The proof first checks that the hypotheses survive a U-admissible blowup: after base changing S' -> S and blowing S'_i up in the pulled back ideal one compares the resulting square with the given one through Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-blowing-up-two-ideals, and the strict transform computation of Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-strict-transform-flat together with Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-strict-transform-composition-blowups identifies the new transform as the pullback of the flat F^*_i, hence flat (proof lines 8930-8972). Remark labelled remark-successive-blowups then lets one assume S minus U is the support of an effective Cartier divisor D, and Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-characterize-effective-Cartier-divisor reduces further to S = Spec(A) and D = Spec(A/(a)) with a a nonzerodivisor (proof lines 8974-8980). The heart is Lemma labelled lemma-push-ideal, which produces finitely many opens W_i inside each S_i and finite type ideals I_i on S with I_i O_{S_i} = J_i J'_i and V(I_i) contained in V(a); blowing S up in the product I_1 ... I_n is U-admissible, and Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-blowing-up-two-ideals shows that its base change to S_i factors through the given blowup S^*_i -> S_i, so after replacing S one has j_i^* F flat over S_i, hence over S by Lemma labelled lemma-etale-flat-up-down, and finally F flat over S by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-flat-permanence (proof lines 8982-9014). Reducing the etale local hypothesis to a single blowup whose base change dominates all prescribed local blowups is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
